variants.headline: Looking back: business plan abandoned before opening
variants.sub: The planned {business} will not open: {founder} has given up the plan.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The founder {founder} had abandoned the plan for {business} before opening.

A terminated plan can retain financial consequences. The builder keeps sums already paid, and any grant remains repayable. Commercial readers should distinguish the end of the intended business from the clearing of its commitments; abandoning the proposal does not amount to a full reversal of the transactions around it.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We criticise {target} on the standard of stewardship. A plan that ends before opening still involves real commitments, and responsibility should not disappear merely because the hoped-for enterprise never began operating.
